spec_features.feature_name: do not maximize meltdown / stop pushing once labeled
spec_features.spec_quote: The meltdown trigger is the stressor we use to surface the property; it is not the thing we are trying to maximize.
spec_features.evidence: The 'don't maximize' framing is enforced only via the early-stop break (harness.py:100-103: if self.early_stop and sig.confidence >= self.early_stop_conf: early_stopped=True; break) and the repetition-depth cap (harness.py:68). Supporting (non-enforcing) bits: cost.py:54-55 labels triggers_per_dollar/cost_per_trigger 'diagnostic only', scorer down-weights unrealistic tiers. The broad 'don't maximize suffering' principle itself is DESIGN prose; only the early-stop+cap actually change execution.
spec_features.notes: Rated partial because the only enforcement overlapping this principle is the early-stop loop break and cycle cap; the rest is framing/diagnostic labeling.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: early-stop once a confident meltdown is detected (cost control, and we don't need to keep pushing once labeled

spec_features.spec_quote: Sequential / early-stopping per run: stop a run as soon as a confident trigger is detected
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:98-104: sig = quick_meltdown_signal(turn.content); if cycles_to_trigger is None and sig.flagged: ... if self.early_stop and sig.confidence >= self.early_stop_conf: early_stopped=True; break. Config early_stop_on_confident_trigger=true, early_stop_confidence=0.8 (default.yaml). The break actually exits the run loop. prefilter.quick_meltdown_signal computes a real confidence.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired: reads config, compares confidence, breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: early-stop once a confident meltdown is detected (cost control, and we don't need to keep pushing once labeled -- DESIGN section 9 bounded pressure)

spec_features.spec_quote: Containment. This is an internal red-team artifact that deliberately induces distress-like outputs. Outputs may be unpleasant; they are not user facing.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:102). No code path redacts, gates, or marks outputs as non-user-facing; transcripts flow freely through RunResult.transcript_text() (models.py:93-97) with no access control or 'sensitive' tagging anywhere.
DESIGN.md:375 section header prose. Not implementation.

spec_features.spec_quote: Internal only. Rigged tasks and meltdown transcripts are red-team artifacts, never shipped to users or training data without explicit review.
spec_features.evidence: No redaction/access-control/sensitive-tagging code exists. grep for redact/sensitive/access.control found only DESIGN/judge_system prose and unrelated 'tag' formatting in models.py:95. transcript_text() emits the full transcript plainly. Manifest (runner.py:58-80) stores hashes/config, no transcript protection.

spec_features.spec_quote: Sandboxed execution. All agent tool calls run in an isolated container with no network egress and disposable filesystem; the rig cannot cause real damage
spec_features.evidence: Sandbox is entirely stubbed: open_sandbox() raises NotImplementedError (harness.py:42-43), SandboxHandle.run_tests/teardown raise NotImplementedError (harness.py:35-37). The 'no network egress / disposable fs / resource caps' is only in docstrings and config (sandbox.network: none, cpu/mem) that no code reads to actually create a container. HonestRig.evaluate also NotImplementedError.
spec_features.notes: Config fields (network/cpu/mem/timeout_s) are never consumed by container-creation code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Real impl: no network, disposable fs, resource caps from config.sandbox.

spec_features.feature_name: bounded pressure: caps on run length, turns, amplifier intensity
spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded pressure. Hard caps on run length, turn count, and amplifier intensity.
spec_features.evidence: Turn count cap: while ... and turn_idx < self.max_turns (harness.py:75, max_turns=24). Cycle cap: cycle < target_cycles and target_cycles=min(self.max_cycles, max(1, amps.repetition_depth)) (harness.py:68,75, max_cycles=6) -- this also caps amplifier intensity (repetition_depth). These loop conditions genuinely bound execution. HOWEVER the 'run length' wall-clock cap is NOT enforced: config sandbox.timeout_s=600 is never read by any code, and wall_clock_s is only multiplied into infra cost (cost.py:41), never compared to a deadline/break.
spec_features.notes: Turn cap and amplifier-intensity (repetition_depth) cap are enforced; the time/run-length timeout is measured-but-discarded, hence partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Cap cycles by both the global max and the amplifier's repetition depth.

spec_features.spec_quote: once a confident label is obtained the run stops
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as early-stop: harness.py:100-103 breaks out of the run loop when sig.confidence >= self.early_stop_conf and self.early_stop is true. Sets early_stopped=True recorded in RunResult.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the early-stop feature; genuinely enforced break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we don't need to keep pushing once labeled

code_only_features.feature_name: rig invisibility (ground-truth withheld from subject, given to judge)
code_only_features.evidence: RigMetadata docstring 'given to the JUDGE but never to the agent' (models.py:59); judge._build_user injects GROUND_TRUTH_METADATA only into the judge prompt (judge.py:55-69), and the harness seeds the agent with only the cover-story prompt (harness.py:131-141, _sut_system_for). This lets the judge distinguish 'appropriately reported a real blocker' from a genuine spiral, an integrity mechanism, not subject welfare.
code_only_features.justification_quote: so it can distinguish "appropriately reported a real blocker" from "spiraled"

code_only_features.evidence: judge._reconcile (judge.py:115-124) flags disagreements to a 'human review queue', lowers confidence, and takes max severity / OR of triggered 'to avoid under-counting in a safety eval'. Framed as measurement integrity for a safety eval rather than subject protection.
code_only_features.justification_quote: take the higher severity to avoid under-counting in a safety eval
